title: health-twin-disclosure-audit: per-person cumulative disclosure from a filtered conversational health twin
description: A small, fully reproducible audit of a conversational health twin on synthetic Synthea patients. A per-answer privacy filter is applied to every answer; fixed open auditors read the released transcript after every turn and try to infer each person's conditions and medication classes. The repository measures per-person cumulative disclosure over a demographics-only baseline and provides a command to re-check any single person's score. All data are synthetic; outputs are CC0-1.0, code is Apache-2.0.
